claim_text: Netanyahu said senior security chiefs chose not to wake him before October 7 because they feared he would order a major alert and thereby trigger an exchange with Hamas; he added that if he had been awakened, the invasion would not have occurred.
discovery_sources: Channel 14 / The Patriots interview; Times of Israel reconstruction; Ynet/PMO chronology; Shin Bet affidavit reporting; ICE interview identification
resolution_notes: Fresh recheck materially strengthens claim reconstruction: Times of Israel independently reconstructs the Aug. 30 Channel 14 interview and the disputed wording at length, while ICE identifies the interview container.
